parts.t: Stunning 4794 SQFT Custom Home situated on a spacious 13,000+ sq ft lot and is designed for both luxury living and unforgettable entertaining. Bright, open-concept layout, soaring ceilings, and premium finishes throughout, this 6-bedroom, 5-bathroom home offers an incredible amount of space. The chef’s kitchen opens seamlessly to the living and dining areas—perfect for hosting. A private 2-bedroom ground-level suite adds flexibility for guests or rental income, while the huge driveway and side access offer tons of parking for RVs, boats, and more. Enjoy ultimate privacy, cozy up by the outdoor fireplace, or unwind in the media room—all enhanced with smart home automation.
